MRFT.description: Moment Redistribution Factor (MRFT). Keyed by element id; can only be assigned to BEAM-type elements, and the single FACTOR value scales the redistributed design moment for that beam.

FACTOR.description: Moment reduction (redistribution) factor applied to the beam element. Applies to BEAM-type elements only. For the Eurocode2:04 concrete design code the value is clamped to a lower bound of 0.7 on write (values below 0.7 are raised to 0.7).
